name: Forgejo
description: Forgejo is a self-hosted, lightweight Git forge focused on community ownership and ethical software practices. Maintained by Codeberg e.V. in Berlin, it provides a full GitHub alternative with repositories, issues, pull requests, and CI/CD runnable on minimal hardware.

owner.name: Codeberg e.V.
owner.description: German non-profit association operating Codeberg and stewarding the Forgejo Git forge project.
